holes.desc: A "hole" is one spot where the copies in a group have the same shape but disagree on a leaf: a field name, a method name, a literal, or a type. The hole count is the number of such spots, which is the number of parameters the shared helper would have to take. Copies differing in anything but leaves (an operator, an extra statement) are not a group at all.
holes.example: `x.health <= n` and `x.attack <= n` are one group with one hole: the field. The helper takes one accessor parameter.
holes.note: A hole at a field or method name costs a closure or accessor parameter, not a plain value, so it is a more expensive extraction than a literal hole. The violation report names the kind of each hole.
